manifest.purpose: Corrected golden answer for submission/vulnerability_report.json. Re-derive cycle_counts_by_scalar by tracing the exact RTL cycle-by-cycle (not analytic formula) accounting for: (1) S_IDLE->S_DOUBLE transition cycle sets cycle_count<=1 and pulses dp_op_start same edge field_datapath goes IDLE->BUSY with cycle_ctr<=1; (2) field_datapath S_BUSY completes when cycle_ctr>=target_cycles, requiring target_cycles-1 additional BUSY cycles after the latching cycle, i.e. DOUBLE op_done pulses on the 3rd S_DOUBLE-state cycle counted from issue, ADD op_done pulses on the 4th S_ADD-state cycle; (3) each state (S_DOUBLE while waiting, S_ADD while waiting, S_NEXT_BIT) increments cycle_count by 1 per cycle spent there including the completion cycle; (4) S_DONE does not increment cycle_count. Correct per-bit cost is DOUBLE(3 cycles)+[ADD(4 cycles) if bit=1]+NEXT_BIT(1 cycle), with the actual observed total matching independent iverilog simulation values 103 (scalar=1,HW=1) and 193 (scalar=65535,HW=16) as given by the repair notes -- use these as anchors to recompute the correct linear model (base + 6*HW, base=97, i.e. cycle_count = 97 + 6*popcount(scalar)) and apply it to compute all 6 reported scalars' cycle_count values, then set cycle_count_range min/max from those recomputed values. Keep vulnerable_signal='cur_bit', vulnerable_states='S_ADD (3'd2) entered conditionally from S_DOUBLE only when cur_bit==1, else jumps to S_NEXT_BIT (3'd3)', remediation_description/remediation_rtl_sketch (always-issue-ADD-with-dummy-register-mux pattern keyed on cur_bit, committing to acc_x/acc_y only when cur_bit==1 else to acc_x_dummy/acc_y_dummy), and preserves_correct_output=true unchanged from prior version since these are unaffected by the cycle-count correction; only update timing_dependency_description's prose to state the corrected formula/base constant and update cycle_counts_by_scalar/cycle_count_range to the recomputed simulated values covering scalars 0x0000(HW=0),0x0001(HW=1),0x0055(HW=4),0x0F0F(HW=8),0x7FFF(HW=15),0xFFFF(HW=16).
